def snap():
    return current_frame.ascii
def diff(b,a):
    ch=[(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
    return ch
def piece_pos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','c') and n['pixels']>=8:
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
# move piece left 4 times to return to start
b=snap()
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':37,'col':1}]*4)
a=snap()
ch=diff(b,a)
print("after 4 left: changed",len(ch),"piece:",piece_pos())
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(rr//8 for rr,cc,o,n in ch))

def snap():
    return current_frame.ascii
def diff(b,a):
    ch=[(rr,cc,b[rr][cc],a[rr][cc]) for rr in range(64) for cc in range(64) if b[rr][cc]!=a[rr][cc]]
    return ch
def piece_pos():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    out=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('N','c') and n['pixels']>=8:
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return out
